name: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
description: Unofficial native PS5 port of Raptor: Call of the Shadows with DualSense controls, pilot saves, edition detection and an optional first-launch download of the free Apogee shareware. Supports your own full-game files and episode packs, controller-based text input and an in-game controls reference. No registered game data or personal saves are included.
author: ChaDea1
